title: Failed logins against many accounts from one source
description: 192.0.2.10 failed to log in to 5 distinct accounts (5 failed attempts) between 2024-03-04T08:30:00Z and 2024-03-04T08:35:00Z. This pattern is associated with password spraying, but shared gateways/NAT, single sign-on outages and scanners can look the same. Requires investigation.
severity_reasons: 5 distinct accounts failed from this address within 10 min (threshold 5): base severity medium | 5 of the 5 targeted account(s) had a successful login from this address shortly afterwards (nina, omar, pat, quinn, ravi); severity not changed because this also happens in benign cases, but check those accounts first
recommended_steps: Check whether the source address is a known shared gateway, VPN or office NAT. | Look for a service outage or recent SSO/password-policy change around these times. | Review the targeted accounts' other recent activity, starting with any that later succeeded. | If the source is unexpected, consider temporary rate limiting or blocking per your policy.
disposition: Requires investigation; not a confirmed incident.

title: Repeated failed logins for one account from one source
description: 12 failed logins for 'admin' from 203.0.113.50 between 2024-03-04T10:03:00Z and 2024-03-04T10:06:45Z (threshold 5 within 10 min). This may indicate password guessing, but a user mistyping a password or a misconfigured client can produce the same pattern. Requires investigation.
severity_reasons: 12 failures within 10 min meets threshold 5: base severity low | 12 failures is at least twice the threshold (10): raised to medium
recommended_steps: Ask whether the account owner recognises this activity. | Check the account's lockout, MFA and recent password-reset state. | Review other activity from the same source address in the same period. | If the source is unexpected, consider rate limiting or blocking per your policy.
disposition: Requires investigation; not a confirmed incident.

title: Successful login shortly after repeated failures
description: A successful login for 'carol' from 203.0.113.23 at 2024-03-04T11:24:45Z came 60 s after 6 failed logins from the same address. This is consistent with a guessed or later-remembered password; the data cannot show which. Requires investigation (not a confirmed compromise).
severity_reasons: success followed 6 repeated failures from the same address: base severity medium (a user who then remembers the password looks identical)
recommended_steps: Contact the account owner through a separate, trusted channel and confirm the login was theirs. | Review what the session did after logging in, using authorised audit logs. | If not recognised, follow your incident process: reset credentials, revoke sessions, check MFA enrolment. | Check whether the source address appears in other alerts.
disposition: Requires investigation; not a confirmed incident.
